INSERT INTO BUSC.DEP_ENTITYINTEREST_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,ENTITY_ID,BANK_ID,ENTITY_TYPE,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS) 

SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.ENTITY_ID,TGT.ENTITY_ID) AS ENTITY_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BANK_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) AS BANK_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.ENTITY_TYPE,TGT.ENTITY_TYPE) AS ENTITY_TYPE

	,CASE WHEN SRC.ENTITY_ID IS NULL AND SRC.ENTITY_TYPE IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.ENTITY_ID IS NULL AND SRC.ENTITY_TYPE IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
        WHEN SRC.ENTITY_ID IN (SELECT ACID FROM D360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE DEL_FLG = 'Y') THEN 'DELETE'
	    WHEN TGT.ENTITY_ID IS NULL AND TGT.ENTITY_TYPE IS NULL AND TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN	TGT
ON	SRC.ENTITY_ID = TGT.ENTITY_ID
AND	SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
AND	SRC.ENTITY_TYPE = TGT.ENTITY_TYPE
	
WHERE	(
	SRC.ENTITY_ID IS NULL
OR	SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL
OR	SRC.ENTITY_TYPE IS NULL
OR	TGT.ENTITY_ID IS NULL
OR	TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL
OR	TGT.ENTITY_TYPE IS NULL
	)
OR	SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
